messages:
chelsea: tiny celebration alert  Luna the tortoise turns 7 today. tiny lettuce cake and a party hat. pic: https://imgur.com/a/LunaCake :turtle:
morgan: that hat is a mood :party_popper: :turtle:
raj: does tortoise cake count as dessert or salad? :thinking: :leafy_green:
chelsea: depends who you ask. Luna demands slow, ceremonial bites. no candles for safety. :candle: x 0
anya: posted still: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F98765/luna_lettuce_cake.jpg
ops-bot: Reminder: For in-person pet visits, complete the short registration and health attestation form: https://redwood.example.com/pet-register :information_source:
morgan: poll: what should Lunas official birthday title be? react :one: "Slow Queen Luna", :two: "Leaf-Loving Monarch", :three: "Keeper of the Sunbeam"
(reactions: raj :one:, anya :two:)
chelsea: also accepting fan art and slow clap videos. Luna appreciates a quiet soundtrack. :musical_note:
ops-bot: Poll results: "Slow Queen Luna" 1, "Leaf-Loving Monarch" 1, "Keeper of the Sunbeam" 0
raj: agreed on "Slow Queen". sending virtual confetti. :confetti_ball:
chelsea: thank you!! will drop a follow-up of Luna refusing party food in protest tomorrow :wave:
